name: SALTASH_HWY_A75_HAWKER_GREEN_FINGERBOARD
notes: Fingerboard with a pointed left end; the drawing gives 'Total width' and 'Varies' for the legend widths, so the width is built from AS 1744 ink widths: 305+405+85+A75(463)+160+Hawker(908)+160 = 2485 (rounded). Height 780. Outline: point at (0,390), sloped edges reach the top/bottom 305 from the tip, R100 at the two right-hand corners (no radius stated for the tip or the obtuse corners; drawn sharp). Green edge 20 + white border 20 built as inward-offset polygons (ground white underneath). Chevron: white band 60 from the top and bottom (660 high), flat right end at x 710 (305+405), sloped edges parallel to the sign point; its top edge is taken as 305 long (405 to 710) which puts the tip at x 147 and the notch at 452 - the 405 position is only confirmed by measuring the drawing (the chevron's tip is not dimensioned). Road-name panel 240 high at y 100, 60 margins around 120 D text (width 1136+120 = 1256), centred between the '=' marks i.e. on the A75 Hawker line (x 795 to 2325). A75 and Hawker baseline 620 (top 460), 160 bottom margin. The diagonal '236' dimension near the top-left corner could not be tied to any feature and is not used.
